cmocs.statement: In undergraduate medical students, participation in the Integrated Cases Section was associated with improved clinical reasoning performance.
cmocs.supporting_quote: Students' clinical reasoning showed a significant gain after the Integrated Cases Section on a script concordance test.

coder_notes: Very limited evidence is available because only the title and abstract excerpt were provided. The excerpt supports an undergraduate medical education context (E01) and an improvement in learning/clinical reasoning performance (E46). Although the abstract mentions increased confidence, there is no matching outcome code for confidence and E04 is a context code rather than an evidenced pre-existing context here, so it was not coded. The intervention details are insufficiently specified to defensibly assign Richmond intervention codes such as real-life scenarios, expert reasoning explanation, or feedback.
